books.title: The Big Short: Inside the Doomsday Machine
books.author: Michael   Lewis
books.review: Excellent story telling of how the financial crisis came to be. Told from the point of view of people within the industry, not the CEOs of big banks, but from the average professional. Michael Lewis does a great job of explaining the events in multiple iterations to make sure the reader understands the specific financial nuances.
